title: IT60101: Foundations Of Computing Systems
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: NoneDigital computer fundamentals: basic building blocks, program
execution, instruction sets and addressing modes, memory organization, I/O,
interrupts. Number representation. Basics of system software. Abstract data
types â stack, queue, list, tree, graph. Binary search trees and Heap. Basic
concepts of algorithms, complexity analysis. Searching and Sorting. Graph
algorithms. Basics of System Software.
